entries.title: Inclined Shelf Book Sorting Cart
entries.description: Original static book sorting cart with two ten-degree backward-inclined shelves, continuous rear backstops, side stops and low front retaining lips. A rigid low chassis, four fixed flat-tread caster assemblies, four continuous uprights and two raised side handles form one functional service cart. Named editable components remain separate. Actual closed-book bottom and rear-face contacts are validated at selected poses; no wheel rotation, steering, load rating or dynamic insertion is promised.

entries.title: Static Long-Shaft Litter Picker
entries.description: Original S01 static long-shaft litter picker with a true open handgrip, short trigger cue, shaft, fixed curved opposing jaws and flat gripping pads. Nine independently editable named mesh components. Actual contact with one unchanged legacy parcel and a lateral-offset collision negative are checked. No trigger linkage, jaw animation, holding-force, dynamic pickup or arbitrary-object grasp claim. See generate.py opening documentation for flat display orientation and fixed pad coordinates.

entries.title: Editable Three-Stream Collection Station
entries.description: Original S01 static collection station with one continuous three-aperture deck, open-front support frame, three independently selectable genuine hollow liners and distinct original category symbols. Finite forward removal positions and a manually removed/set-down example are checked with an unchanged legacy parcel and separately reused paving. One kit. No waste-rule, dynamic removal, capacity or public-facility certification. See generate.py opening documentation for exact named-node coordinates and installation.

entries.title: Harvested Pear Carrot and Cabbage Set
entries.description: Original editable harvested-food kit containing a shouldered pear with a thin stem, one complete tapered carrot with three folded leaves, and a rounded cabbage with three thick overlapping outer leaves. Each food uses a distinct continuous volume and named closed components, rather than recoloured sphere variants. Muted whole-food colours, no labels or external textures. Three foods count as one set ID. Static display placement only; no food preparation, growth, deformation or physical simulation.

entries.title: Ventilated Stackable Produce Crate
entries.description: Original single-specification .46 by .28 by .22 m open produce crate with a continuous closed shell, real ventilation holes, 110 by 43 mm end grip apertures, four outer corner landing pads and four lower inward locator tongues. Muted reusable-container material. Actual same-ID two-instance stacking and upright placement on the unchanged parcel handtruck are checked at documented poses. No load rating, dynamic transport, carrying stability, nesting or material-strength certification.

entries.title: Quiet-Room Single Bed Kit
entries.description: Original static single-bed functional kit with four legs, framed rails, five real mattress cross supports, headboard, one 1 by 2 metre mattress, pillow and closed softly folded cover. Seventeen named editable mesh parts; one family asset. Actual support patches and flat bedding contacts are checked with displaced and lifted negative fixtures. Fixed cloth geometry only, without fabric, occupant, load or mechanism simulation. Existing cabinet and unlit lamp are separately reused in the documented room display.

entries.title: Fixed Pedestal Styling Chair
entries.description: Original fixed-pose salon styling chair with a broad flat-bottomed tapered pedestal, fixed two-stage column, seat mounting block, padded seat and back, two armrests with genuine open-side supports, and a forward foot platform carried by two sloped struts and a crossmember. Distinct professional seat structure, original low-poly silhouette and muted upholstery/metal finish. Independently editable parts in one static asset. No hydraulic lift, swivel, recline, load rating, electrical or ergonomic certification.

entries.title: Static Bypass Floral Stem Snips
entries.description: Original low-poly bypass floral stem snips with two curved blades in genuinely offset planes, two separate padded handles, two bored hubs, a fixed pin and positive-area bearing seats. Four upper-half meshes share one named editable pivot. Default near-closed pose retains a visible blade gap; a second fixed open pose at -40 degrees is verified by actual imported-world vertex transformations, mesh collision checks and bore/seat evidence. Original unmodified flower stem fits only the tested open alignment. No severing, continuous cutting sweep, spring action, force, gripping, load or safety certification.

entries.title: Clamp-On Flat-Jaw Bench Vise
entries.description: Original compact clamp-on flat-jaw bench vise with fixed rear jaw, separate front jaw, rectangular slide guide, visible screw and cross handles, and a continuous table-edge C frame with lower pressure pad. Seventeen editable closed parts in one fixed 80mm jaw opening and 50mm table gap. Actual unchanged worktable top/underside contact and original long stock side contact are checked with misplaced and overwide negative fixtures. Mounting datum is documented; no ground placement, screw motion, clamp force, cantilever stability or load rating is claimed.

entries.title: Floor-Standing Document Copier
entries.description: Original generic floor-standing copier with four bearing feet, a real open output recess and supported collection tray, separate scanner cover and feeder silhouette, two fixed cassette fronts with modeled blind grip recesses, and a tilted opaque control screen. Twenty editable closed parts in one static closed-service pose. Self-contained QA checks an external A4 rectangular fixture on the actual tray, an overwide fixture and a disconnected-tray negative. Old organizing table and storage cabinet are adjacent context only. No printing, scanning, paper-feed, electrical-safety or continuous mechanism simulation.

entries.title: Fixed Raised Pet Grooming Wash Station
entries.description: Original fixed raised pet-care washing station with one thick true basin cavity, blind sump floor, nine standing slats with eight real slots, two interior bearing ledges, four grounded legs and connected frame, a tall splashback and a fixed hose with parked hand spray. Basin width1.16m and depth.64m, standing surface .64m, rim .88m; 53mm clear space beneath the grate. Independent named editable components in one static assembly. QA rectangular envelope only establishes empty-cavity geometry, not fit for any real animal. No animal model, access ramp, hydraulic lift, flowing water, hose motion, plumbing, load, waterproof, sanitary, veterinary or grooming-safety certification.

entries.title: Fixed Single Group Countertop Coffee Machine
entries.description: Original fixed single-group countertop coffee appliance, with four grounded pads and chassis, plain body, group-head shoulder and cylinder, locked filter bowl and separate grip, fixed delivery tip, parked rigid steam wand, opaque abstract controls and a true shallow drip well supporting a continuous grate with 11 actual through-slots. Static editable components only; no portafilter removal/rotation, steam-wand movement, brewing, heat, pressure, water, electricity or food-safety capability. A separate validated display uses the unchanged original kitchen mug at unit scale and original worktable; finite mug-height/offset and machine-overhang fixtures are diagnostic only.

entries.title: Open Garden Drum Composter
entries.description: Original hollow garden drum composter on two braced A-frames, with a genuine front access cavity, two small through slots, two real polygonal spindle-bearing bores and a separately editable curved cover fixed open. Twenty-three closed editable parts form one static garden-service appliance. Self-contained geometry checks validate actual lower spindle-facet contact, displaced-axle collision negatives, clear interior/access volumes and through-slot rays. Original nursery rack and planted tray are adjacent context only. No compost output, biological-performance, load, stability or continuous rotation guarantee.

entries.title: Public Pedestal Drinking Station
entries.description: Original fixed outdoor pedestal drinking station with a real open lateral basin, sloping inner floor and recessed drain floor, side arm and diagonal brace, protected fixed bubbler, upper open-front cup alcove, solid ledge and fixed downward outlet. Static editable components only. Actual original open mug and paving node are used separately for bounded geometric support and clearance checks. No water flow, pressure, plumbing, drinking or hygiene safety, accessibility, frost or load certification; no operating or continuous insertion capability.

entries.title: Fixed Indoor Table Football
entries.description: Original fixed indoor table-football assembly with four feet and legs, tied frame, supported recessed marked field, two real goal openings into local enclosed pockets, eight rods through sixteen bored side bearings, fixed locating collars, eight grips and twenty-two solid figures in opposed 1-2-5-3 team arrangements. Full reported dimensions include all grips and end pockets. Named editable static components at one centered pose only; no telescopic or continuous rod movement, playable ball physics, scoring, complete ball-return route, load or child-safety certification. Original floor selection and full actual foot support are verified separately.

entries.title: Harbor Cargo and Rest Platform Preset
entries.description: 4m static cargo/rest platform preset reusing 9 published Harbor IDs at v1.0.0 as 12 independently selectable rigid instances: west cargo, northeast seating and open center. No new standalone prop, water or shore connection. Exact source commit and hashes embedded in generator. Original 12mm deck seams and bench/rope contact limits retained; offline review only.

entries.title: Original Medium Bench Drill Press
entries.description: Original static workshop bench drill press with a planar cast base, rear steel column, bored adjustable-height table, separate support arm and sleeves, quill and chuck, fixed fluted bit, enclosed belt cover, rear motor, and three-spoke feed handle. Limited teal, steel and charcoal palette. Independent closed editable parts in one fixed pose. No anchoring system has been supplied or certified. No motion, drilling performance, load capacity, workholding suitability, or safety certification is claimed.

entries.title: Original Compact Twin-Wheel Bench Grinder
entries.description: Original static compact horizontal twin-wheel bench grinder in a limited S01 palette. Separate planar base, pedestal, horizontal motor, coaxial spindle, bored wheels, flanges, thick open-front guards, bolted tool-rest brackets, upper deflectors and front rocker. Four restrained teal, steel, charcoal and rough gray wheel PBR materials. No movement, grinding performance, anchoring, load capacity, manufacturability, or safety certification is claimed.

entries.title: Two-Bay Fresh Market Handoff Preset
entries.description: Static game layout: two complete published produce stalls, shared rear prep table with whole produce kit, and two side-pocket two-crate stacks. Separate front public and rear external handoff/storage interfaces. Stall interior has nominal 1.95m beam clearance and does not pass a 1.95m-body workflow. Exterior routes terminate at handoff points outside canopy. External flat ground Z=0 required. Seven named game ports and full reserved-route data are embedded in the GLB. Custom regions use preset-local Blender Z-up metres and map to glTF Y-up by (x,y,z) to (x,z,-y). No moving navigation, accessibility, commercial, load or dynamics certification.

entries.title: Coffee Order to Ceramic Pickup Layout
entries.description: Two complete front service-counter modules with separate order and ceramic-mug pickup regions; rear complete worktable carries original static machine facing the independent staff lane. Existing ceramic mug, not a takeaway container. Original materials and beveled modular seam retained. Static game-layout regions only; no brewing, payment, navigation or safety claim.

entries.title: Standing Copier Pickup and Document Staging
entries.description: Static standing copy-pickup to tabletop document-staging preset with complete unchanged legacy floor copier, worktable and reused shallow metal tray; two independently editable original A4 nodes occupy pickup and storage endpoints. Finite standing/access metadata includes Blender/glTF coordinates. Authored static paper thickness .0002m, not a manufacturing claim. No printing, feeding, bending, drawer motion, human-reach or compliance simulation. Reconstructed r2 source; independent acceptance required.

entries.title: Original Mobile Canister Workshop Dust Collector
entries.description: Original static mobile single-stage workshop dust collector: hollow pleated upper canister, open collector plenum, separate opaque lower collection bag, side blower and motor, bare open inlet, retaining clamps, rear push handle, steel supports and four bored caster wheels. Limited teal, satin steel, charcoal and warm pale PBR palette. No connected hose, validated mating fit, motion, collection or filtration performance, health protection, explosion protection, load rating, operation, manufacture or safety certification is claimed.

entries.title: Original Compact Two-Wheel Bench Band Saw
entries.description: Original fixed-pose compact workshop band saw with four planar feet, C-shaped rear frame, horizontal upper and lower axles, bored spoked wheels, one continuous closed toothed blade, closed wheel housings with actual band exits, correctly oriented upper and lower three-bearing guides, slotted table and insert, supported curved trunnion ears, direct rear motor, tension knob, front switch and hollow dust port. Limited teal, steel and charcoal PBR palette. All dimensions are author design values. Independent editable mesh components. No motion, cutting, anchoring, loading, manufacturability or safety certification is claimed.

entries.title: Timber Shop House with Upper Dwelling
entries.description: Original static S03 two-storey shop-house shell on a 4 x 6 m wall-centre grid. Lower display opening and fixed entry board, distinct upper dwelling windows, real floor decks, aligned timber columns, ring-and-joist upper floor, thick gables, clay roof and integral stone steps. Named child mesh identities are preserved under eleven static parent groups.
